body: Task M1.5 (wad-102) — QA PASSED. Branch sbx/m1.5-compat-run, commit a31e4827b2af59add5a51541e28fe019712e44be. Real test results: pytest -q -> 99 passed, 1 xfailed, exit 0 (developer's run); QA independently re-ran in a fresh isolated .venv -> 99 passed, exit 0, same xfail confirmed pre-existing/flaky and unrelated to this diff. QA also independently verified the live e2e claim structurally (on-PATH handoff byte-identical to the acp shim; reference bash handoff reproduced field-for-field in an isolated FACTORY_DIR). Ready to push. Non-blocking note: QA found a doc-accuracy nit in agent-comms/docs/m1.5-compat-check.md — it states the bash reference's rand() suffix is '10 chars' but QA traced it to actually be '6 random chars + shell PID' (variable length) due to a pipefail/SIGPIPE interaction in the reference script; doesn't affect the pass/fail conclusion or the tick, just a follow-up correction worth making to the doc.
